Investigated. Here's what I found and my honest read of Mani's feedback — because it's ambiguous, and getting the *direction* right matters before another rewrite.

## What the investigation shows
- **SFCC-122 is now in "Code Review"** — so Mani's comment *is* the formal review. Parent epic is **SFCC-1 "Platform Setup & Environments" — Mani's epic.** So he owns the context this spike serves.
- **The ticket asks for an "inventory," not a TSD.** Objective/Tasks/DoD say *"document available MRT APIs: endpoint structure, payload, authentication, data available"* and *"a documented inventory of relevant MRT APIs."* It never says "produce a TSD." We (on your earlier directive) restructured it into the full problem/options/decision **TSD template** — that's a genre shift away from what the card literally asked for.
- **There's already a "Technical Solution Design – PWA" page (256835585)** covering PWA architecture broadly (stack, customisation model, integrations, multi-site, SSR/SEO, perf, a11y, CI/CD). Our doc's §5 (config file:line refs, hooks, the `useProductSearch` block, MRT proxy wiring) **overlaps that** — which is almost certainly why Mani says *"this looks like just explaining PWA impl."*

## My honest read of Mani's critique (and it has validity)
He's the ticket author and platform-epic owner. He asked for a **consolidated MRT/SFCC capability inventory** ("what does the platform expose, what can it serve for product/category/pricing"). What he's looking at instead reads, to him, like **a PWA-implementation writeup + a decision narrative** (Options A-D, interim data-loading, config internals) — much of which overlaps the existing TSD-PWA.

I'll own my part: across our iterations the doc absorbed a lot of PWA-impl detail and options/decision scaffolding (the TSD-template restructure, §5 implementation, the data-loading options). That drift is real, and it's what Mani is reacting to. The **core inventory the card wanted is in there (§5.3)** — but it's buried inside impl/decision material, so it doesn't read as "the MRT API capability inventory."

## The catch — his feedback is genuinely ambiguous
*"Just explaining PWA impl / consolidated tech details"* could mean either:
- **"Too much PWA impl — refocus on the SFCC/MRT capability inventory"** (most likely, given the card), **or**
- **"I expected consolidated tech details and this is more of a narrative/PWA rehash"** (a format/shape complaint).

Both point roughly the same way, but the *exact* target shape (lean inventory vs. keep-TSD-but-refocus) is his call — and we've spent many cycles, so I don't want to rewrite on a guess.

## Recommendation
**Get one specific clarification from Mani, with a proposed direction attached**, then refactor. My proposed direction (pending his confirm): **refocus SFCC-122 to a lean MRT/SCAPI capability inventory matching the four ticket tasks** — endpoints, payload, auth, what each serves, what can serve product/category/pricing now, limitations/gaps, permanent-vs-workaround — and **cut the PWA-implementation detail + the interim data-loading options/decision** (or reduce them to a short pointer), **de-duplicated against the existing TSD-PWA**.

A note on codebase: I did consider it, but Mani's concern is the doc's *shape/scope*, not code accuracy (which we've already verified). Nothing in the code changes this assessment.

## Offer
Want me to **draft a short Teams reply to Mani** that (a) reflects his point back to confirm I've got it, and (b) proposes that refocus with 2-3 concrete options for him to pick — so we refine in the right direction in one pass? Or if you'd rather just act, I can **produce the leaner inventory version** as my best interpretation and you run it by him. Which?

# SFCC MRT API Capabilities: Spike Findings (SFCC-122)

> **Draft for squad review.** SFCC-122 spike deliverable: a documented inventory of the SFCC APIs available through MRT for product, category, and pricing consumption, and what can be built and tested in the lower environments before the AP21/MuleSoft feed is ready.

| | |
|---|---|
| Jira | SFCC-122 (Spike, Squad-A; epic SFCC-1 Platform Setup) |
| Author | Angelo Navarro, Squad-A / FED Lead |
| Status | Draft, for review |
| Verified against | dev sandbox `bkzk-002`, local PWA run, 24 Jul 2026 |

---

## 1. Summary

- **What "MRT API" means here.** Managed Runtime is the PWA Kit hosting/proxy layer. Product, category, and pricing data are served by **SCAPI (Salesforce Commerce API, the Shopper APIs)**, reached through the MRT proxy (`/mobify/proxy/api`). The separate Managed Runtime Admin API is platform / CI-CD and out of scope.
- **The APIs are ready; data was the gap.** SCAPI can serve product, category, and pricing today. At spike outset the sandbox had no data because the AP21-to-SFCC feed is not built yet.
- **Dev is now seeded and verified.** `bkzk-002` has categories, pricebooks, inventory, and one sample product (priced, in stock, with a working promotion strikethrough), all consumable via SCAPI with no app-code change.
- **Interim data is manual; scale and real data need AP21.** The current sample was hand-created in Business Manager; broader and real data depend on the permanent AP21-to-MuleSoft-to-SFCC feed (SFCC-121).

---

## 2. MRT API inventory (Task 1)

The storefront consumes SFCC through the MRT proxy path `/mobify/proxy/api`, base host `{shortCode}.api.commercecloud.salesforce.com` (Dev: shortCode `qmyt7hks`, org `f_ecom_bkzk_002`, site `ZimmermannAU`). Authentication is **SLAS private-client** (guest and registered tokens; the client secret is held server-side). Requests and responses are JSON over TLS.

APIs relevant to product, category, and pricing:

| API family | Path root | Data served | Verbs | Auth |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shopper Products | `/product/shopper-products/v1/*` | Product detail (master/variant, images), **price** (`priceRanges` per pricebook), and the **category tree** (`getCategory`) | GET | SLAS |
| Shopper Search | `/search/shopper-search/v1/*` | Category product listing (`cgid` refinement), keyword search, faceting, sort | GET | SLAS |
| Shopper Login (SLAS) | `/checkout/shopper-login/oauth2/*` | Guest and registered auth; the enabler for every read above | GET, POST | n/a |

**Payload conventions.** The storefront pulls related data in one call with `expand` (e.g. `expand=prices,promotions,variations,images`) and `perPricebook=true` for pricebook-aware pricing. Promotions surface as `productPromotions` (a `calloutMsg`, and a `promotionalPrice` at the variant level).

**Out of scope** (other problems, documented elsewhere): cart and checkout (Shopper Baskets, Shopper Orders), account and wishlist (Shopper Customers), personalization (Shopper Context, Einstein), OCAPI (configured but not called by app code), MuleSoft direct reads, and the Managed Runtime Admin API.

---

## 3. What can serve product, category, and pricing now (Task 2)

Verified by a local PWA run against dev `bkzk-002` (24 Jul 2026), SCAPI network traffic captured:

| Capability | API | Verified result |
|---|---|---|
| Category tree | Shopper Products `getCategory` | `clothing` and `new-arrivals` return 200; navigable |
| Category listing / search | Shopper Search | `product-search?refine=cgid=clothing` returns 200 (`total: 1`) |
| Product detail | Shopper Products | `4673TS251` returns 200 with attributes, images, variants |
| Price | Shopper Products (`expand=prices`, `perPricebook`) | 625 AUD from pricebook `au-aud-list-prices` |
| Discount / strikethrough | promotions via `expand=promotions` | 10% promo returns `promotionalPrice` 562.50 at variant level; PDP renders A$562.50 against a struck A$625 |
| Inventory | on the product record | `inventory_m_au`, ats 10, orderable |
| Auth | SLAS | guest token issued and accepted |

**Conclusion:** SCAPI serves product, category, pricing, and promotional pricing in dev today, and the storefront renders them with **no code change**. Consumption is not the blocker.

---

## 4. Current data state and how it is populated

- **Dev `bkzk-002` (verified 24 Jul).** Categories, pricebooks, and inventory are configured; one sample product (`4673TS251`) is present, priced and in stock with a working promotion. Business Manager first-time setup (storefront-catalogue assignment, search-index rebuild) is done. IDs in use: master catalogue `zimmermann-catalog`, storefront catalogues `zimmermann-<site>-storefront-catalog`, pricebooks `{site}-{currency}-list-prices` (e.g. `au-aud-list-prices`), inventory list `inventory_m_au`.
- **Interim (now).** Sample data is **created manually in Business Manager** by platform, because there is no AP21-to-SFCC integration yet. Additional sample data is also manual.
- **Permanent.** Product and catalogue via **AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC**; price via **AP21 to SFCC pricebook import** (there is no pricebook write API, so price is always file-based). This feed is SFCC-121's build.

*Loading-mechanism sources: Confluence Business Manager Configuration Management (309657601) and the Catalogue Sync pages (312508418, 315490342). Whether a documented `data/sample` bulk-import set exists for the sandbox is unconfirmed (open item).*

---

## 5. Limitations and gaps (Task 3)

To be covered by AP21/MuleSoft (SFCC-121) or platform:

- **Data breadth.** Dev has a single hand-made style, not enough for scale, faceting, or listing tests. More requires manual creation until the feed exists.
- **Product attributes not final.** The attribute model is still under discussion (SFCC-121); attribute-bound PDP/PLP work may need rework.
- **Sale-pricebook path unexercised.** Discount display is verified via a **promotion**; the sale-pricebook ("was/now") path is a separate mechanism and has not been tested.
- **Other sites and tiers unconfirmed.** Only `ZimmermannAU` on dev is verified; other storefronts and non-dev tiers are not checked.
- **Permanent feed pending.** AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC is not built; SFCC-121 is "Ready for Development", pending product-attribute discussions.

---

## 6. Permanent vs workaround (Task 4)

| Element | Classification |

## 1. Summary

Product, category, and pricing data are served by **SCAPI (Salesforce Commerce API, the Shopper APIs)**, reached through the MRT proxy (`/mobify/proxy/api`). The separate Managed Runtime Admin API is platform / CI-CD and out of scope.

- **Dev is now seeded and verified.** `bkzk-002` has categories, pricebooks, inventory, and one sample product (priced, in stock, with a working promotion strikethrough), all consumable via SCAPI with no app-code change.
- **Interim data is manual; scale and real data need AP21.** The current sample was hand-created in Business Manager; broader and real data depend on the permanent AP21-to-MuleSoft-to-SFCC feed (SFCC-121).

---

## 2. MRT API inventory (Task 1)

The storefront consumes SFCC through the MRT proxy path `/mobify/proxy/api`, base host `{shortCode}.api.commercecloud.salesforce.com` (Dev: shortCode `qmyt7hks`, org `f_ecom_bkzk_002`, site `ZimmermannAU`). Authentication is **SLAS private-client** (guest and registered tokens; the client secret is held server-side). Requests and responses are JSON over TLS.

APIs relevant to product, category, and pricing:

| API family | Path root | Data served | Verbs | Auth |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shopper Products | `/product/shopper-products/v1/*` | Product detail (master/variant, images), **price** (`priceRanges` per pricebook), and the **category tree** (`getCategory`) | GET | SLAS |
| Shopper Search | `/search/shopper-search/v1/*` | Category product listing (`cgid` refinement), keyword search, faceting, sort | GET | SLAS |
| Shopper Login (SLAS) | `/checkout/shopper-login/oauth2/*` | Guest and registered auth; the enabler for every read above | GET, POST | n/a |

**Payload conventions.** The storefront pulls related data in one call with `expand` (e.g. `expand=prices,promotions,variations,images`) and `perPricebook=true` for pricebook-aware pricing. Promotions surface as `productPromotions` (a `calloutMsg`, and a `promotionalPrice` at the variant level).

**Out of scope** (other problems, documented elsewhere): cart and checkout (Shopper Baskets, Shopper Orders), account and wishlist (Shopper Customers), personalization (Shopper Context, Einstein), OCAPI (configured but not called by app code), MuleSoft direct reads, and the Managed Runtime Admin API.

---

## 3. What can serve product, category, and pricing now (Task 2)

Verified by a local PWA run against dev `bkzk-002` (24 Jul 2026), SCAPI network traffic captured:

| Capability | API | Verified result |
|---|---|---|
| Category tree | Shopper Products `getCategory` | `clothing` and `new-arrivals` return 200; navigable |
| Category listing / search | Shopper Search | `product-search?refine=cgid=clothing` returns 200 (`total: 1`) |
| Product detail | Shopper Products | `4673TS251` returns 200 with attributes, images, variants |
| Price | Shopper Products (`expand=prices`, `perPricebook`) | 625 AUD from pricebook `au-aud-list-prices` |
| Discount / strikethrough | promotions via `expand=promotions` | 10% promo returns `promotionalPrice` 562.50 at variant level; PDP renders A$562.50 against a struck A$625 |
| Inventory | on the product record | `inventory_m_au`, ats 10, orderable |
| Auth | SLAS | guest token issued and accepted |

**Conclusion:** SCAPI serves product, category, pricing, and promotional pricing in dev today, and the storefront renders them with **no code change**. Consumption is not the blocker.

---

## 4. Current data state and how it is populated

- **Dev `bkzk-002` (verified 24 Jul).** Categories, pricebooks, and inventory are configured; one sample product (`4673TS251`) is present, priced and in stock with a working promotion. Business Manager first-time setup (storefront-catalogue assignment, search-index rebuild) is done. IDs in use: master catalogue `zimmermann-catalog`, storefront catalogues `zimmermann-<site>-storefront-catalog`, pricebooks `{site}-{currency}-list-prices` (e.g. `au-aud-list-prices`), inventory list `inventory_m_au`.
- **Interim (now).** Sample data is **created manually in Business Manager** by platform, because there is no AP21-to-SFCC integration yet. Additional sample data is also manual.
- **Permanent.** Product and catalogue via **AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC**; price via **AP21 to SFCC pricebook import** (there is no pricebook write API, so price is always file-based). This feed is SFCC-121's build.

*Loading-mechanism sources: Confluence Business Manager Configuration Management (309657601) and the Catalogue Sync pages (312508418, 315490342). Whether a documented `data/sample` bulk-import set exists for the sandbox is unconfirmed (open item).*

---

## 5. Limitations and gaps (Task 3)

To be covered by AP21/MuleSoft (SFCC-121) or platform:

- **Data breadth.** Dev has a single hand-made style, not enough for scale, faceting, or listing tests. More requires manual creation until the feed exists.
- **Product attributes not final.** The attribute model is still under discussion (SFCC-121); attribute-bound PDP/PLP work may need rework.

SFCC-122 "Spike: Document SFCC MRT API Capabilities" — Jira Spike, project SFCC (zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net), label Squad-A, High, **In Progress**, assigned to Marcel, reported by Jasmijn Tsang. Sibling spikes: SFCC-121 (Validate MuleSoft Sync, Victor Crisostomo, Ready for Dev), SFCC-123 (Contentful design, Jhoan Rose, In Progress). Board spike house style: Objective / Background / Tasks / Definition of Done (see [[f2r-spike]]).

Objective: document the MRT (Managed Runtime) APIs available for product, category, and pricing so the squad knows what can be built/tested in lower environments while MuleSoft is not yet ready. Background note: "Angelo (=Marcel) to set up session with Mani." Mani = Manikandan Ramachandran (owns SFCC-1 Platform Setup & Environments epic).

**Crux finding (the reframe the spike needs):** MRT is primarily the PWA Kit hosting/proxy layer. IMPORTANT correction (per official MRT docs, audited 2026-07-22): there IS a real "Managed Runtime API" but it is an ADMIN/deployment REST API (mrt-admin: environments/targets, bundles, deploy, redirects, proxies, env vars, CDN invalidation, access-control headers, certs, users), NOT a commerce-data API. The deliverable's original flat claim "MRT is not an API" was WRONG; corrected via audit fixes B1-B4 (applied 2026-07-23, doc + Confluence page now v3). Accurate framing now in the doc (3.1.0, 3.1.9): the MRT Admin API = platform admin/CI-CD (out of scope for this spike), while product/category/pricing data comes via SCAPI reached through the MRT proxy (/mobify/proxy/api). Audit also added an MRT platform capabilities/constraints table (render timeout 20s/16s, 6MB req/resp, cookies-off-by-default/allow_cookies, bundle limits, reserved /mobify prefix, built-in env vars, edge services, ap-southeast-2 region). Product/category/pricing reach the PWA via **SCAPI Shopper APIs** (shopper-products v1, shopper-search v1, shopper-promotions v1) proxied through MRT (`/mobify/proxy/api`, shortCode `qmyt7hks`), using `@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react` v5.2.0 hooks with SLAS private-client auth. OCAPI is a proxied fallback (`/mobify/proxy/ocapi`, dev sandbox `bkzk-002`). MuleSoft does NOT serve product/price to the PWA — its role there is the server-to-server AP21→MuleSoft→SFCC catalogue import (OCAPI Data API or SFTP). Price is separate: AP21→SFCC via pricebook XML import (sfcc-ci / BM Site Import), and per TSD Price (292388871) there is NO direct MuleSoft price integration; mechanism (SFTP/API/MuleSoft) is TBC. Pricebook IDs: `{site}-{currency}-list-prices`/`-sale-prices` (e.g. `au-aud-list-prices`). So SCAPI is fully capable NOW; the real blocker is that SFCC has no catalog/price data yet because that MuleSoft feed isn't built.

**Unblock lower envs:** load catalog + pricebook data into the SFCC sandbox via BM or OCAPI Data API so the PWA can consume via SCAPI immediately. Sample-catalog tooling (`data/sample/catalogs`, `data:import:sample`) is NOT in zimmermann-pwa — it lives in the separate `zimmermann-sfccworkplace` cartridge repo (per Confluence TSD Product page 292061208). The PWA repo only consumes. Confluence coverage checked 2026-07-23 (Mani's "most info is in Confluence" = largely TRUE): BM Config Mgmt (309657601) documents source-controlled `data/core` (catalogue IDs `zimmermann-catalog` + `zimmermann-*-storefront-catalog` now CONFIRMED real; pricebooks/inventory = empty shells, structure only) and sandbox creation via the `zimmermann-sfcc-admin` GitHub Action; loading approach in Catalogue Sync TSDs (312508418 file-based recommended, 315490342 SCAPI Admin API alternative). NB per 315490342: OCAPI is deprecated, admin writes use SCAPI Admin APIs (AmOAuth2), and PRICE has no write API so is ALWAYS file-based (WebDAV + `sfcc-site-archive-import`). `data/core` auto-imported vs `data/sample` manual demo load per Build&Deploy (264896514). GAP not in Confluence = current runtime state of `bkzk-002` (what is actually loaded now) → that is the Victor part (Victor Crisostomo owns SFCC-121 Validate MuleSoft Sync). UPDATE 2026-07-23: Angelo ran the PWA locally against dev and captured the network calls. Dev `bkzk-002` IS populated: categories (`clothing` levels=2, `new-arrivals`) returned 200; `product-search` with `cgid` returned 200 (~3.3 kB); and the PDP `shopper-products` call for master `4673TS251` (the TSD's own example style) returned 200 (~3.5 kB) with `expand=prices/promotions/availability`, `currency=AUD`. So the "empty data" premise does NOT hold for dev, the sample/seed catalogue appears already loaded, and open item #1 is largely answered for dev. Confirmed via response bodies 2026-07-23: price 625 AUD sourced from pricebook `au-aud-list-prices` (loaded AND assigned to ZimmermannAU); inventory `inventory_m_au` has stock (ats 10, orderable=true); the repeated 404 was `shopper-context/v1` for the guest USID (expected/benign, NOT Einstein as I first guessed). KEY NUANCE: the seed is THIN, `product-search cgid=clothing` returned total=1 (single master style `4673TS251` "Illuminate Fitted Blouse", 6 variants), so dev is populated but minimal, fine for UI/PDP/PLP/cart wiring, not for scale/faceting/sale-price testing. Still open for Victor: data completeness/representativeness, other sites/tiers, permanent feed timeline. STATUS 2026-07-24 (CURRENT): v0.5 is PUBLISHED to Confluence page 349437965 (page version 12; v0.5 adds verified promotion-driven strikethrough: `4673TS251` A$625 → A$562.50 via a 10% test promo, `productPromotions.promotionalPrice` at variant level, `price`/`priceRanges` stay list — NOT a sale pricebook), title "[DRAFT] TSD: SFCC MRT API Capabilities (Spike SFCC-122)", under 05.1. # SFCC MRT API Capabilities: Spike Findings (SFCC-122)

> **Draft for squad review.** SFCC-122 spike deliverable: a documented inventory of the SFCC APIs available through MRT for product, category, and pricing consumption, and what can be built and tested in the lower environments before the AP21/MuleSoft feed is ready.

| | |
|---|---|
| Jira | SFCC-122 (Spike, Squad-A; epic SFCC-1 Platform Setup) |
| Author | Angelo Navarro, Squad-A / FED Lead |
| Status | Draft, for review |
| Verified against | dev sandbox `bkzk-002`, local PWA run, 24 Jul 2026 |

---

## 1. Summary

- **What "MRT API" means here.** Managed Runtime is the PWA Kit hosting/proxy layer. Product, category, and pricing data are served by **SCAPI (Salesforce Commerce API, the Shopper APIs)**, reached through the MRT proxy (`/mobify/proxy/api`). The separate Managed Runtime Admin API is platform / CI-CD and out of scope.
- **The APIs are ready; data was the gap.** SCAPI can serve product, category, and pricing today. At spike outset the sandbox had no data because the AP21-to-SFCC feed is not built yet.
- **Dev is now seeded and verified.** `bkzk-002` has categories, pricebooks, inventory, and one sample product (priced, in stock, with a working promotion strikethrough), all consumable via SCAPI with no app-code change.
- **Interim data is manual; scale and real data need AP21.** The current sample was hand-created in Business Manager; broader and real data depend on the permanent AP21-to-MuleSoft-to-SFCC feed (SFCC-121).

---

## 2. MRT API inventory (Task 1)

The storefront consumes SFCC through the MRT proxy path `/mobify/proxy/api`, base host `{shortCode}.api.commercecloud.salesforce.com` (Dev: shortCode `qmyt7hks`, org `f_ecom_bkzk_002`, site `ZimmermannAU`). Authentication is **SLAS private-client** (guest and registered tokens; the client secret is held server-side). Requests and responses are JSON over TLS.

APIs relevant to product, category, and pricing:

| API family | Path root | Data served | Verbs | Auth |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shopper Products | `/product/shopper-products/v1/*` | Product detail (master/variant, images), **price** (`priceRanges` per pricebook), and the **category tree** (`getCategory`) | GET | SLAS |
| Shopper Search | `/search/shopper-search/v1/*` | Category product listing (`cgid` refinement), keyword search, faceting, sort | GET | SLAS |
| Shopper Login (SLAS) | `/checkout/shopper-login/oauth2/*` | Guest and registered auth; the enabler for every read above | GET, POST | n/a |

**Payload conventions.** The storefront pulls related data in one call with `expand` (e.g. `expand=prices,promotions,variations,images`) and `perPricebook=true` for pricebook-aware pricing. Promotions surface as `productPromotions` (a `calloutMsg`, and a `promotionalPrice` at the variant level).

**Out of scope** (other problems, documented elsewhere): cart and checkout (Shopper Baskets, Shopper Orders), account and wishlist (Shopper Customers), personalization (Shopper Context, Einstein), OCAPI (configured but not called by app code), MuleSoft direct reads, and the Managed Runtime Admin API.

---

## 3. What can serve product, category, and pricing now (Task 2)

Verified by a local PWA run against dev `bkzk-002` (24 Jul 2026), SCAPI network traffic captured:

| Capability | API | Verified result |
|---|---|---|
| Category tree | Shopper Products `getCategory` | `clothing` and `new-arrivals` return 200; navigable |
| Category listing / search | Shopper Search | `product-search?refine=cgid=clothing` returns 200 (`total: 1`) |
| Product detail | Shopper Products | `4673TS251` returns 200 with attributes, images, variants |
| Price | Shopper Products (`expand=prices`, `perPricebook`) | 625 AUD from pricebook `au-aud-list-prices` |
| Discount / strikethrough | promotions via `expand=promotions` | 10% promo returns `promotionalPrice` 562.50 at variant level; PDP renders A$562.50 against a struck A$625 |
| Inventory | on the product record | `inventory_m_au`, ats 10, orderable |
| Auth | SLAS | guest token issued and accepted |

**Conclusion:** SCAPI serves product, category, pricing, and promotional pricing in dev today, and the storefront renders them with **no code change**. Consumption is not the blocker.

---

## 4. Current data state and how it is populated

- **Dev `bkzk-002` (verified 24 Jul).** Categories, pricebooks, and inventory are configured; one sample product (`4673TS251`) is present, priced and in stock with a working promotion. Business Manager first-time setup (storefront-catalogue assignment, search-index rebuild) is done. IDs in use: master catalogue `zimmermann-catalog`, storefront catalogues `zimmermann-<site>-storefront-catalog`, pricebooks `{site}-{currency}-list-prices` (e.g. `au-aud-list-prices`), inventory list `inventory_m_au`.
- **Interim (now).** Sample data is **created manually in Business Manager** by platform, because there is no AP21-to-SFCC integration yet. Additional sample data is also manual.
- **Permanent.** Product and catalogue via **AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC**; price via **AP21 to SFCC pricebook import** (there is no pricebook write API, so price is always file-based). This feed is SFCC-121's build.

*Loading-mechanism sources: Confluence Business Manager Configuration Management (309657601) and the Catalogue Sync pages (312508418, 315490342). Whether a documented `data/sample` bulk-import set exists for the sandbox is unconfirmed (open item).*

---

## 5. Limitations and gaps (Task 3)

To be covered by AP21/MuleSoft (SFCC-121) or platform:

- **Data breadth.** Dev has a single hand-made style, not enough for scale, faceting, or listing tests. More requires manual creation until the feed exists.
- **Product attributes not final.** The attribute model is still under discussion (SFCC-121); attribute-bound PDP/PLP work may need rework.
- **Sale-pricebook path unexercised.** Discount display is verified via a **promotion**; the sale-pricebook ("was/now") path is a separate mechanism and has not been tested.
- **Other sites and tiers unconfirmed.** Only `ZimmermannAU` on dev is verified; other storefronts and non-dev tiers are not checked.
- **Permanent feed pending.** AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC is not built; SFCC-121 is "Ready for Development", pending product-attribute discussions.

---

## 6. Permanent vs workaround (Task 4)

| Element | Classification |
|---|---|
| SCAPI-via-MRT for product/category/pricing consumption | **Permanent** (the storefront's supported model; no code change needed) |
| SLAS private-client auth via MRT | **Permanent** |
| AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC catalogue feed; AP21 to SFCC price feed | **Permanent** (data population; not yet built) |
| Manual Business Manager creation of sample data | **Workaround** (interim only; throwaway once the feed delivers) |
| OCAPI via MRT | Configured fallback; currently unused |

---

## 7. Open items and follow-ups (owner: Victor / platform)

- A broader sample-data set for front-end testing (multiple styles across categories).
- Whether the documented `data/sample` import works against `bkzk-002` (would enable a bulk load instead of manual creation).
- Product-attribute model finalisation (SFCC-121).
- The sale-pricebook ("was/now") path, if production markdowns are modelled as pricebooks rather than promotions.
- Per-site and per-tier seeding beyond AU/dev.
- Timeline for the permanent AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC feed (SFCC-121).

---

# SFCC MRT API Capabilities: Spike Findings (SFCC-122)

> **Draft for squad review.** SFCC-122 spike deliverable: a documented inventory of the SFCC APIs available through MRT for product, category, and pricing consumption, and what can be built and tested in the lower environments before the AP21/MuleSoft feed is ready.

| | |
|---|---|
| Jira | SFCC-122 (Spike, Squad-A; epic SFCC-1 Platform Setup) |
| Author | Angelo Navarro, Squad-A / FED Lead |
| Status | Draft, for review |
| Verified against | dev sandbox `bkzk-002`, local PWA run, 24 Jul 2026 |

---

## 1. Summary

- **What "MRT API" means here.** Managed Runtime is the PWA Kit hosting/proxy layer. Product, category, and pricing data are served by **SCAPI (Salesforce Commerce API, the Shopper APIs)**, reached through the MRT proxy (`/mobify/proxy/api`). The separate Managed Runtime Admin API is platform / CI-CD and out of scope.
- **The APIs are ready; data was the gap.** SCAPI can serve product, category, and pricing today. At spike outset the sandbox had no data because the AP21-to-SFCC feed is not built yet.
- **Dev is now seeded and verified.** `bkzk-002` has categories, pricebooks, inventory, and one sample product (priced, in stock, with a working promotion strikethrough), all consumable via SCAPI with no app-code change.
- **Interim data is manual; scale and real data need AP21.** The current sample was hand-created in Business Manager; broader and real data depend on the permanent AP21-to-MuleSoft-to-SFCC feed (SFCC-121).

---

## 2. MRT API inventory (Task 1)

The storefront consumes SFCC through the MRT proxy path `/mobify/proxy/api`, base host `{shortCode}.api.commercecloud.salesforce.com` (Dev: shortCode `qmyt7hks`, org `f_ecom_bkzk_002`, site `ZimmermannAU`). Authentication is **SLAS private-client** (guest and registered tokens; the client secret is held server-side). Requests and responses are JSON over TLS.

APIs relevant to product, category, and pricing:

| API family | Path root | Data served | Verbs | Auth |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shopper Products | `/product/shopper-products/v1/*` | Product detail (master/variant, images), **price** (`priceRanges` per pricebook), and the **category tree** (`getCategory`) | GET | SLAS |
| Shopper Search | `/search/shopper-search/v1/*` | Category product listing (`cgid` refinement), keyword search, faceting, sort | GET | SLAS |
| Shopper Login (SLAS) | `/shopper/auth/v1/*` (`oauth2` token and JWKS) | Guest and registered auth; the enabler for every read above | GET, POST | n/a |

**Payload conventions.** The storefront pulls related data in one call with `expand` (e.g. `expand=prices,promotions,variations,images`) and `perPricebook=true` for pricebook-aware pricing. Promotions surface as `productPromotions` (a `calloutMsg`, and a `promotionalPrice` at the variant level).

**Out of scope** (other problems, documented elsewhere): cart and checkout (Shopper Baskets, Shopper Orders), account and wishlist (Shopper Customers), personalization (Shopper Context, Einstein), OCAPI (configured but not called by app code), MuleSoft direct reads, and the Managed Runtime Admin API.

---

## 3. What can serve product, category, and pricing now (Task 2)

Verified by a local PWA run against dev `bkzk-002` (24 Jul 2026), SCAPI network traffic captured:

| Capability | API | Verified result |
|---|---|---|
| Category tree | Shopper Products `getCategory` | `clothing` and `new-arrivals` return 200; navigable |
| Category listing / search | Shopper Search | `product-search?refine=cgid=clothing` returns 200 (`total: 1`) |
| Product detail | Shopper Products | `4673TS251` returns 200 with attributes, images, variants |
| Price | Shopper Products (`expand=prices`, `perPricebook`) | 625 AUD from pricebook `au-aud-list-prices` |
| Discount / strikethrough | promotions via `expand=promotions` | 10% promo returns `promotionalPrice` 562.50 at variant level; PDP renders A$562.50 against a struck A$625 |
| Inventory | on the product record | `inventory_m_au`, ats 10, orderable |
| Auth | SLAS | guest token issued and accepted |

**Conclusion:** SCAPI serves product, category, pricing, and promotional pricing in dev today, and the storefront renders them with **no code change**. Consumption is not the blocker.

---

## 4. Current data state and how it is populated

- **Dev `bkzk-002` (verified 24 Jul).** Categories, pricebooks, and inventory are configured; one sample product (`4673TS251`) is present, priced and in stock with a working promotion. Business Manager first-time setup (storefront-catalogue assignment, search-index rebuild) is done. IDs in use: master catalogue `zimmermann-catalog`, storefront catalogues `zimmermann-<site>-storefront-catalog`, pricebooks `{site}-{currency}-list-prices` (e.g. `au-aud-list-prices`), inventory list `inventory_m_au`.
- **Interim (now).** Sample data is **created manually in Business Manager** by platform, because there is no AP21-to-SFCC integration yet. Additional sample data is also manual.
- **Permanent.** Product and catalogue via **AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC**; price via **AP21 to SFCC pricebook import** (there is no pricebook write API, so price is always file-based). This feed is SFCC-121's build.

*Loading-mechanism sources: Confluence Business Manager Configuration Management (309657601) and the Catalogue Sync pages (312508418, 315490342). Whether a documented `data/sample` bulk-import set exists for the sandbox is unconfirmed (open item).*

---

## 5. Limitations and gaps (Task 3)

To be covered by AP21/MuleSoft (SFCC-121) or platform:

- **Data breadth.** Dev has a single hand-made style, not enough for scale, faceting, or listing tests. More requires manual creation until the feed exists.
- **Product attributes not final.** The attribute model is still under discussion (SFCC-121); attribute-bound PDP/PLP work may need rework.
- **Sale-pricebook path unexercised.** Discount display is verified via a **promotion**; the sale-pricebook ("was/now") path is a separate mechanism and has not been tested.
- **Other sites and tiers unconfirmed.** Only `ZimmermannAU` on dev is verified; other storefronts and non-dev tiers are not checked.
- **Permanent feed pending.** AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC is not built; SFCC-121 is "Ready for Development", pending product-attribute discussions.

---

## 6. Permanent vs workaround (Task 4)

| Element | Classification |
|---|---|
| SCAPI-via-MRT for product/category/pricing consumption | **Permanent** (the storefront's supported model; no code change needed) |
| SLAS private-client auth via MRT | **Permanent** |
| AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC catalogue feed; AP21 to SFCC price feed | **Permanent** (data population; not yet built) |
| Manual Business Manager creation of sample data | **Workaround** (interim only; throwaway once the feed delivers) |
| OCAPI via MRT | Configured fallback; currently unused |

---

## 7. Open items and follow-ups (owner: Victor / platform)

- A broader sample-data set for front-end testing (multiple styles across categories).
- Whether the documented `data/sample` import works against `bkzk-002` (would enable a bulk load instead of manual creation).
- Product-attribute model finalisation (SFCC-121).
- The sale-pricebook ("was/now") path, if production markdowns are modelled as pricebooks rather than promotions.
- Per-site and per-tier seeding beyond AU/dev.
- Timeline for the permanent AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC feed (SFCC-121).

---

- Victor Crisostomo: sandbox and follow-up answers (23-24 Jul 2026).

- 24 Jul 2026: Reshaped from the earlier TSD-formatted draft into a spike findings / inventory doc, per review feedback (a spike needs findings, not a problem/options/decision TSD; removed PWA-implementation detail that overlapped the PWA TSD). Content carried over verified against dev and Victor.

# SFCC MRT API Capabilities: Spike Findings (SFCC-122)

> **Draft for squad review.** SFCC-122 spike deliverable: a documented inventory of the SFCC APIs available through MRT for product, category, and pricing consumption, and what can be built and tested in the lower environments before the AP21/MuleSoft feed is ready.

| | |
|---|---|
| Jira | SFCC-122 (Spike, Squad-A; epic SFCC-1 Platform Setup) |
| Author | Angelo Navarro, Squad-A / FED Lead |
| Status | Draft, for review |
| Verified against | dev sandbox `bkzk-002`, local PWA run, 23-24 Jul 2026 |

---

## 1. Summary

- **What "MRT API" means here.** Managed Runtime is the PWA Kit hosting/proxy layer. Product, category, and pricing data are served by **SCAPI (Salesforce Commerce API, the Shopper APIs)**, reached through the MRT proxy (`/mobify/proxy/api`). The separate Managed Runtime Admin API is platform / CI-CD and out of scope.
- **The APIs are ready; data was the gap.** SCAPI can serve product, category, and pricing today. At spike outset the sandbox had no data because the AP21-to-SFCC feed is not built yet.
- **Dev is now seeded and verified.** `bkzk-002` has categories, pricebooks, inventory, and one sample product (priced, in stock, with a working promotion strikethrough), all consumable via SCAPI with no app-code change.
- **Interim data is manual; scale and real data need AP21.** The current sample was hand-created in Business Manager; broader and real data depend on the permanent AP21-to-MuleSoft-to-SFCC feed (SFCC-121).

---

## 2. MRT API inventory (Task 1)

The storefront consumes SFCC through the MRT proxy path `/mobify/proxy/api`, base host `{shortCode}.api.commercecloud.salesforce.com` (Dev: shortCode `qmyt7hks`, org `f_ecom_bkzk_002`, site `ZimmermannAU`). Authentication is **SLAS private-client** (guest and registered tokens; the client secret is held server-side). Requests and responses are JSON over TLS.

APIs relevant to product, category, and pricing:

| API family | Path root | Data served | Verbs | Auth |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shopper Products | `/product/shopper-products/v1/*` | Product detail (master/variant, images), **price** (`priceRanges` per pricebook), and the **category tree** (`getCategory`) | GET | SLAS |
| Shopper Search | `/search/shopper-search/v1/*` | Category product listing (`cgid` refinement), keyword search, faceting, sort | GET | SLAS |
| Shopper Login (SLAS) | `/shopper/auth/v1/*` (`oauth2` token and JWKS) | Guest and registered auth; the enabler for every read above | GET, POST | n/a |

**Payload conventions.** The storefront pulls related data in one call with `expand` (e.g. `expand=prices,promotions,variations,images`) and `perPricebook=true` for pricebook-aware pricing. Promotions surface as `productPromotions` (a `calloutMsg`, and a `promotionalPrice` at the variant level).

**Out of scope** (other problems, documented elsewhere): cart and checkout (Shopper Baskets, Shopper Orders), account and wishlist (Shopper Customers), personalization (Shopper Context, Einstein), OCAPI (configured but not called by app code), MuleSoft direct reads, and the Managed Runtime Admin API.

---

## 3. What can serve product, category, and pricing now (Task 2)

Verified by a local PWA run against dev `bkzk-002` (23-24 Jul 2026), SCAPI network traffic captured:

| Capability | API | Verified result |
|---|---|---|
| Category tree | Shopper Products `getCategory` | `clothing` and `new-arrivals` return 200; navigable |
| Category listing / search | Shopper Search | `product-search?refine=cgid=clothing` returns 200 (`total: 1`) |
| Product detail | Shopper Products | `4673TS251` returns 200 with attributes, images, variants |
| Price | Shopper Products (`expand=prices`, `perPricebook`) | 625 AUD from pricebook `au-aud-list-prices` |
| Discount / strikethrough | promotions via `expand=promotions` | 10% promo returns `promotionalPrice` 562.50 at variant level; PDP renders A$562.50 against a struck A$625 |
| Inventory | on the product record | `inventory_m_au`, ats 10, orderable |
| Auth | SLAS | guest token issued and accepted |

**Conclusion:** SCAPI serves product, category, pricing, and promotional pricing in dev today, and the storefront renders them with **no code change**. Consumption is not the blocker.

---

## 4. Current data state and how it is populated

- **Dev `bkzk-002` (verified 23-24 Jul).** Categories, pricebooks, and inventory are configured; one sample product (`4673TS251`) is present, priced and in stock with a working promotion. Business Manager first-time setup (storefront-catalogue assignment, search-index rebuild) is done. IDs in use: master catalogue `zimmermann-catalog`, storefront catalogues `zimmermann-<site>-storefront-catalog`, pricebooks `{site}-{currency}-list-prices` (e.g. `au-aud-list-prices`), inventory list `inventory_m_au`.
- **Interim (now).** Sample data is **created manually in Business Manager** by platform, because there is no AP21-to-SFCC integration yet. Additional sample data is also manual.
- **Permanent.** Product and catalogue via **AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC**; price via **AP21 to SFCC pricebook import** (there is no pricebook write API, so price is always file-based). This feed is SFCC-121's build.

*Loading-mechanism sources: Confluence Business Manager Configuration Management (309657601) and the Catalogue Sync pages (312508418, 315490342). Whether a documented `data/sample` bulk-import set exists for the sandbox is unconfirmed (open item).*

---

## 5. Limitations and gaps (Task 3)

To be covered by AP21/MuleSoft (SFCC-121) or platform:

- **Data breadth.** Dev has a single hand-made style, not enough for scale, faceting, or listing tests. More requires manual creation until the feed exists.
- **Product attributes not final.** The attribute model is still under discussion (SFCC-121); attribute-bound PDP/PLP work may need rework.
- **Sale-pricebook path unexercised.** Discount display is verified via a **promotion**; the sale-pricebook ("was/now") path is a separate mechanism and has not been tested.
- **Other sites and tiers unconfirmed.** Only `ZimmermannAU` on dev is verified; other storefronts and non-dev tiers are not checked.
- **Permanent feed pending.** AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC is not built; SFCC-121 is "Ready for Development", pending product-attribute discussions.

---

## 6. Permanent vs workaround (Task 4)

| Element | Classification |
|---|---|
| SCAPI-via-MRT for product/category/pricing consumption | **Permanent** (the storefront's supported model; no code change needed) |
| SLAS private-client auth via MRT | **Permanent** |
| AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC catalogue feed; AP21 to SFCC price feed | **Permanent** (data population; not yet built) |
| Manual Business Manager creation of sample data | **Workaround** (interim only; throwaway once the feed delivers) |
| OCAPI via MRT | Configured fallback; currently unused |

---

## 7. Open items and follow-ups (owner: Victor / platform)

- A broader sample-data set for front-end testing (multiple styles across categories).
- Whether the documented `data/sample` import works against `bkzk-002` (would enable a bulk load instead of manual creation).
- Product-attribute model finalisation (SFCC-121).
- The sale-pricebook ("was/now") path, if production markdowns are modelled as pricebooks rather than promotions.
- Per-site and per-tier seeding beyond AU/dev.
- Timeline for the permanent AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC feed (SFCC-121).

---

- Codebase (`zimmermann-pwa`): `.docs/integration/01-sfcc.md`, `03-mulesoft.md`; `config/default.js`; `overrides/app/pages/home/index.tsx`, `.../components/_app-config/index.tsx`, `.../ssr.js`.
- Confluence (space SFCC): Business Manager Configuration Management (309657601); Catalogue Sync (312508418, 315490342); TSD Product (292061208); TSD Price (292388871); Technical Solution Design, PWA (256835585).
- Jira (project SFCC): SFCC-122, SFCC-121 (Validate MuleSoft Sync), SFCC-1 (Platform Setup).
- Verification: local PWA run against dev `bkzk-002`, SCAPI network capture, 24 Jul 2026.
- Victor Crisostomo: sandbox and follow-up answers (23-24 Jul 2026).

---

## Changelog

- 24 Jul 2026: Reshaped from the earlier TSD-formatted draft into a spike findings / inventory doc, per review feedback (a spike needs findings, not a problem/options/decision TSD; removed PWA-implementation detail that overlapped the PWA TSD). Content carried over verified against dev and Victor.

# SFCC MRT API Capabilities: Spike Findings (SFCC-122)

> **Draft for squad review.** SFCC-122 spike deliverable: a documented inventory of the SFCC APIs available through MRT for product, category, and pricing consumption, and what can be built and tested in the lower environments before the AP21/MuleSoft feed is ready.

| | |
|---|---|
| Jira | SFCC-122 (Spike, Squad-A; epic SFCC-1 Platform Setup) |
| Author | Angelo Navarro, Squad-A / FED Lead |
| Status | Draft, for review |
| Verified against | dev sandbox `bkzk-002`, local PWA run, 23-24 Jul 2026 |

---

## 1. Summary

- **What "MRT API" means here.** Managed Runtime is the PWA Kit hosting/proxy layer. Product, category, and pricing data are served by **SCAPI (Salesforce Commerce API, the Shopper APIs)**, reached through the MRT proxy (`/mobify/proxy/api`). The separate Managed Runtime Admin API is platform / CI-CD and out of scope.
- **The APIs are ready; data was the gap.** SCAPI can serve product, category, and pricing today. At spike outset the sandbox had no data because the AP21-to-SFCC feed is not built yet.
- **Dev is now seeded and verified.** `bkzk-002` has categories, pricebooks, inventory, and one sample product (priced, in stock, with a working promotion strikethrough), all consumable via SCAPI with no app-code change.
- **Interim data is manual; scale and real data need AP21.** The current sample was hand-created in Business Manager; broader and real data depend on the permanent AP21-to-MuleSoft-to-SFCC feed (SFCC-121).

---

## 2. MRT API inventory (Task 1)

The storefront consumes SFCC through the MRT proxy path `/mobify/proxy/api`, base host `{shortCode}.api.commercecloud.salesforce.com` (Dev: shortCode `qmyt7hks`, org `f_ecom_bkzk_002`, site `ZimmermannAU`). Authentication is **SLAS private-client** (guest and registered tokens; the client secret is held server-side). Requests and responses are JSON over TLS.

APIs relevant to product, category, and pricing:

| API family | Path root | Data served | Verbs | Auth |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shopper Products | `/product/shopper-products/v1/*` | Product detail (master/variant, images), **price** (`priceRanges` per pricebook), and the **category tree** (`getCategory`) | GET | SLAS |
| Shopper Search | `/search/shopper-search/v1/*` | Category product listing (`cgid` refinement), keyword search, faceting, sort | GET | SLAS |
| Shopper Login (SLAS) | `/shopper/auth/v1/*` (`oauth2` token and JWKS) | Guest and registered auth; the enabler for every read above | GET, POST | n/a |

**Payload conventions.** The storefront pulls related data in one call with `expand` (e.g. `expand=prices,promotions,variations,images`) and `perPricebook=true` for pricebook-aware pricing. Promotions surface as `productPromotions` (a `calloutMsg`, and a `promotionalPrice` at the variant level).

**Out of scope** (other problems, documented elsewhere): cart and checkout (Shopper Baskets, Shopper Orders), account and wishlist (Shopper Customers), personalization (Shopper Context, Einstein), OCAPI (configured but not called by app code), MuleSoft direct reads, and the Managed Runtime Admin API.

---

## 3. What can serve product, category, and pricing now (Task 2)

Verified by a local PWA run against dev `bkzk-002` (23-24 Jul 2026), SCAPI network traffic captured:

| Capability | API | Verified result |
|---|---|---|
| Category tree | Shopper Products `getCategory` | `clothing` and `new-arrivals` return 200; navigable |
| Category listing / search | Shopper Search | `product-search?refine=cgid=clothing` returns 200 (`total: 1`) |
| Product detail | Shopper Products | `4673TS251` returns 200 with attributes, images, variants |
| Price | Shopper Products (`expand=prices`, `perPricebook`) | 625 AUD from pricebook `au-aud-list-prices` |
| Discount / strikethrough | promotions via `expand=promotions` | 10% promo returns `promotionalPrice` 562.50 at variant level; PDP renders A$562.50 against a struck A$625 |
| Inventory | on the product record | `inventory_m_au`, ats 10, orderable |
| Auth | SLAS | guest token issued and accepted |

**Conclusion:** SCAPI serves product, category, pricing, and promotional pricing in dev today, and the storefront renders them with **no code change**. Consumption is not the blocker.

---

## 4. Current data state and how it is populated

- **Dev `bkzk-002` (verified 23-24 Jul).** Categories, pricebooks, and inventory are configured; one sample product (`4673TS251`) is present, priced and in stock with a working promotion. Business Manager first-time setup (storefront-catalogue assignment, search-index rebuild) is done. IDs in use: master catalogue `zimmermann-catalog`, storefront catalogues `zimmermann-<site>-storefront-catalog`, pricebooks `{site}-{currency}-list-prices` (e.g. `au-aud-list-prices`), inventory list `inventory_m_au`.
- **Interim (now).** Sample data is **created manually in Business Manager** by platform, because there is no AP21-to-SFCC integration yet. Additional sample data is also manual.
- **Permanent.** Product and catalogue via **AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC**; price via **AP21 to SFCC pricebook import** (there is no pricebook write API, so price is always file-based). This feed is SFCC-121's build.

*Loading-mechanism sources: Confluence Business Manager Configuration Management (309657601) and the Catalogue Sync pages (312508418, 315490342). Whether a documented `data/sample` bulk-import set exists for the sandbox is unconfirmed (open item).*

---

## 5. Limitations and gaps (Task 3)

To be covered by AP21/MuleSoft (SFCC-121) or platform:

- **Data breadth.** Dev has a single hand-made style, not enough for scale, faceting, or listing tests. More requires manual creation until the feed exists.
- **Product attributes not final.** The attribute model is still under discussion (SFCC-121); attribute-bound PDP/PLP work may need rework.
- **Sale-pricebook path unexercised.** Discount display is verified via a **promotion**; the sale-pricebook ("was/now") path is a separate mechanism and has not been tested.
- **Other sites and tiers unconfirmed.** Only `ZimmermannAU` on dev is verified; other storefronts and non-dev tiers are not checked.
- **Permanent feed pending.** AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC is not built; SFCC-121 is "Ready for Development", pending product-attribute discussions.

---

## 6. Permanent vs workaround (Task 4)

| Element | Classification |
|---|---|
| SCAPI-via-MRT for product/category/pricing consumption | **Permanent** (the storefront's supported model; no code change needed) |
| SLAS private-client auth via MRT | **Permanent** |
| AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC catalogue feed; AP21 to SFCC price feed | **Permanent** (data population; not yet built) |
| Manual Business Manager creation of sample data | **Workaround** (interim only; throwaway once the feed delivers) |
| OCAPI via MRT | Configured fallback; currently unused |

---

## 7. Open items and follow-ups (owner: Victor / platform)

- A broader sample-data set for front-end testing (multiple styles across categories).
- Whether the documented `data/sample` import works against `bkzk-002` (would enable a bulk load instead of manual creation).
- Product-attribute model finalisation (SFCC-121).
- The sale-pricebook ("was/now") path, if production markdowns are modelled as pricebooks rather than promotions.
- Per-site and per-tier seeding beyond AU/dev.
- Timeline for the permanent AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC feed (SFCC-121).

---

## References

- Codebase (`zimmermann-pwa`): `.docs/integration/01-sfcc.md`, `03-mulesoft.md`; `config/default.js`; `overrides/app/pages/home/index.tsx`, `.../components/_app-config/index.tsx`, `.../ssr.js`, `.../ssr/slasTokens.ts`.
- Confluence (space SFCC): Business Manager Configuration Management (309657601); Catalogue Sync (312508418, 315490342); TSD Product (292061208); TSD Price (292388871); Technical Solution Design, PWA (256835585).
- Jira (project SFCC): SFCC-122, SFCC-121 (Validate MuleSoft Sync), SFCC-1 (Platform Setup).
- Verification: local PWA run against dev `bkzk-002`, SCAPI network capture, 23-24 Jul 2026.
- Victor Crisostomo: sandbox and follow-up answers (23-24 Jul 2026).

---

content.text:
Confirmed — and it's verified in the code, not just asserted. **Substantially yes, with one precision on the wording.**

## What's true (Mani is right)
The Zimmermann storefront consumes product, category, and pricing entirely through **ready-made hooks that ship with the template** — nobody builds or designs these APIs:
- The project **extends `@salesforce/retail-react-app` 10.0.0** ([package.json:18,23](../zimmermann-pwa/package.json)) — pure template extensibility.
- Product/category/pricing come from **`@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react` hooks** used as-is: `useProductSearch` ([home/index.tsx:36,52](../zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/pages/home/index.tsx)), `useProduct` (productHero.tsx:16, hotspotPopup.tsx:12). The home-page call is even labelled *"From PWA template - Example on how to show products."*
- **No custom product/category/price API client exists** in the overrides — my grep for hand-rolled `fetch`/`axios` touching product/category/price returned **nothing**.
- The MRT proxy (`/mobify/proxy/api`) and SLAS auth are PWA Kit config (config:131, ssr.js:52).

So the consumption path is genuinely out-of-the-box, zero custom API code.

## The one precision (so it's airtight)
The **APIs themselves are SFCC B2C Commerce platform APIs (SCAPI Shopper APIs)** — they live on the SFCC instance and exist independently of PWA Kit. What "comes with PWA Kit" is the **out-of-the-box *client* to consume them**: the `commerce-sdk-react` hooks, the `/mobify/proxy/api` proxy, SLAS auth, and the retail-react-app wiring. (Tellingly, `commerce-sdk-react` isn't even a top-level dependency — it arrives transitively *through* the template, which reinforces "it comes bundled.")

So the precise statement is: **"Product/category/pricing use standard SCAPI Shopper APIs, consumed out-of-the-box via the PWA Kit / retail-react-app SDK with no custom API code."**

## Why this matters for the spike
This *is* the crux: because consumption is OOTB and standard, there was never anything to build on the API side — the only gap was **data in the instance**. Mani's point actually reinforces the doc's core message.

**Doc implication:** the reshaped draft says "no code change" / "consumable via SCAPI" but doesn't yet state the OOTB point explicitly. I'd add one line to §2 to foreground it and match Mani's framing, e.g.:

> *These are standard SFCC platform APIs (SCAPI); the PWA Kit / retail-react-app SDK provides out-of-the-box consumption (the `commerce-sdk-react` hooks, the MRT proxy, and SLAS auth), used here with no custom API code.*

Want me to fold that into §2 before we push?

-----------

Pricing in the Zimmermann SFCC platform is managed through a per-site, per-currency **pricebook** structure. Each site has a list price (RRP) and a sale price pricebook for each currency it supports. For Global-e sites (USIntl, EUIntl, ME, HK), SFCC holds prices in the base currency; Global-e handles currency conversion and localisation at checkout.

There is no direct MuleSoft price integration. Price feeds are expected to originate from **AP21** and are loaded into SFCC via data import (XML pricebooks).

---

2. Pricebook Architecture
-------------------------

### 2.1 Naming Convention

Defaultnone{site}-{currency}-list-prices ← RRP / list price

Sale pricebooks reference their parent list pricebook:

Defaultxml<header pricebook-id="au-aud-sale-prices">

<parent>au-aud-list-prices</parent>
</header>

SFCC resolves the effective price by checking the sale pricebook first, then falling back to list.

==================================================================================

This document defines how Business Manager configuration is managed across environments — what lives in source control, what is applied once at sandbox creation, and what is owned directly in BM.

> **Audience:** Architects, Senior Developers, Platform Team

---

principlesPrinciples
--------------------

| Principle | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Source-controlled config** | Structural metadata that must be consistent across all environments lives in `data/` and is imported via `sfcc-ci instance:import` |
| **Automated first-time config** | Instance-level settings (WebDAV, OCAPI) are applied once at sandbox creation via the `zimmermann-sfcc-admin` GitHub Action — never manually |
| **BM-owned config** | Operational and merchandising config that varies per environment or changes frequently is managed directly in BM and is not in source control |

---

1-sourcecontrolled--datacore1. Source-Controlled — `data/core/`
---------------------------------------------------------------

Imported via `npm run data:import:core`. Re-importable at any time; safe to re-run on an existing sandbox.

| Asset | Path | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Site definitions | `sites/{SiteID}/site.xml` | Currency, taxation, cartridge path |
| Site preferences | `sites/{SiteID}/preferences.xml` | Catalog, locales, pricebooks, inventory list assignments |
| Search profiles | `sites/{SiteID}/search2.xml` | Sorting rules, search refinements |
| Storefront catalogs | `catalogs/zimmermann-*-storefront-catalog/` | Category structure per site |
| Master catalog | `catalogs/zimmermann-catalog/` | Shared product classification |
| Pricebooks | `pricebooks/*.xml` | Empty shells — structure only, no prices |
| Inventory lists | `inventory-lists/*.xml` | Empty shells — structure only, no stock |
| Shared library | `libraries/ZimmermannSharedLibrary/` | Shared content library |
| Customer list | `customer-lists/ZimmermannCommon.xml` | Shared customer list |
| System object extensions | `meta/system-objecttype-extensions.xml` | Custom attributes on standard objects |
| Custom object definitions | `meta/custom-objecttype-definitions.xml` | Custom object types |
| Org-level preferences | `preferences.xml` | ActiveLocales |

**Rule:** If a structural change needs to be the same on every sandbox, staging, and production — it belongs here.

---

2-sourcecontrolled--datavendor2. Source-Controlled — `data/vendor/`
-------------------------------------------------------------------

Imported via `npm run data:import:vendor`. Maintained manually — never auto-generated.

| Vendor | What's imported |
| --- | --- |
| Global-e | Services, jobs, custom object type definitions, system object extensions, payment methods, shipping methods |
| Avalara | Services, custom preferences, tax class metadata |

**Rule:** When a vendor package is upgraded, a developer manually copies the relevant metadata into `data/vendor/<vendor>/` and commits it. `vendor:install` only copies cartridges.

---

3-automated-firsttime--zimmermannsfccadmin-github-action3. Automated First-Time — `zimmermann-sfcc-admin` GitHub Action
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Applied **once** when a sandbox is created via the `Create Sandbox` GitHub Action in the [zimmermann-sfcc-admin](https://github.com/ZimmermannAU/zimmermann-sfcc-admin) repo. Not re-imported after that.

| Setting | Where applied | Managed after creation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| WebDAV client permissions | Passed to `sfcc-ci sandbox:create --webdav-settings` | Directly in BM if changed |
| OCAPI Data API settings | Passed to `sfcc-ci sandbox:create --ocapi-settings` | Directly in BM if changed |
| OCAPI Shop API settings | Passed to `sfcc-ci sandbox:create --ocapi-settings` | Directly in BM if changed |

These configs live in the `zimmermann-sfcc-admin` repo, not in `sfccworkplace`.

**Rule:** These are instance-level settings that the sandbox API only needs at creation time. If you need to update them on a running sandbox, do it directly in BM → Administration.

---

4-bmowned--not-in-source-control4. BM-Owned — Not in Source Control
-------------------------------------------------------------------

These are configured directly in Business Manager and are not tracked in this repo. They vary per environment or are owned by non-developers.

### 4a-onetime--firsttime-setup-done-once-per-sandbox-then-bmowned4a. One-time / First-time Setup (done once per sandbox, then BM-owned)

| Configuration | BM Path |
| --- | --- |
| Storefront catalog assignment per site | BM → Merchant Tools → Catalog → Manage Catalogs → assign to site |
| Code version activation | BM → Administration → Code Deployment |
| Search index rebuild | BM → Merchant Tools → Search → Search Indexes → rebuild |
| Site map generation | BM → Merchant Tools → SEO → Sitemaps |

### 4b-operational-config-ongoing-bmowned4b. Operational Config (ongoing, BM-owned)

| Configuration | BM Path | Who manages |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Payment processors | BM → Merchant Tools → Ordering → Payment Processors | Platform team |
| Shipping methods & rates | BM → Merchant Tools → Ordering → Shipping | Merchandising |
| Tax rates & tables | BM → Merchant Tools → Ordering → Taxation | Finance / Platform |
| Promotions & coupons | BM → Merchant Tools → Marketing | Merchandising |
| Email templates | BM → Merchant Tools → Content → Email | Marketing |
| A/B test configs | BM → Merchant Tools → Online Marketing | Merchandising |
| Job schedules | BM → Administration → Operations → Jobs | Platform team |
| Log levels | BM → Administration → Operations → Log Center | Platform team |

### 4c-credentials--secrets-never-in-source-control4c. Credentials & Secrets (never in source control)

| Configuration | Where it lives |
| --- | --- |
| Payment gateway credentials | BM → Site Preferences → Custom Preferences |
| Global-e merchant token | BM → Site Preferences → Custom Preferences → GlobalE\_\* |
| Avalara account credentials | BM → Site Preferences → Custom Preferences → AvaTax\_\* |
| SFCC AM client secret | GitHub Secrets → `SFCC_CLIENT_SECRET` (admin repo only) |

# SFCC MRT API Capabilities: Spike Findings (SFCC-122)

> **Draft for squad review.** SFCC-122 spike deliverable: a documented inventory of the SFCC APIs available through MRT for product, category, and pricing consumption, and what can be built and tested in the lower environments before the AP21/MuleSoft feed is ready.

| | |
|---|---|
| Jira | SFCC-122 (Spike, Squad-A; epic SFCC-1 Platform Setup) |
| Author | Angelo Navarro, Squad-A / FED Lead |
| Status | Draft, for review |
| Verified against | dev sandbox `bkzk-002`, local PWA run, 23-24 Jul 2026 |

---

## 1. Summary

- **What "MRT API" means here.** Managed Runtime is the PWA Kit hosting/proxy layer. Product, category, and pricing data are served by **SCAPI (Salesforce Commerce API, the Shopper APIs)**, reached through the MRT proxy (`/mobify/proxy/api`). The separate Managed Runtime Admin API is platform / CI-CD and out of scope.
- **The APIs are ready; data was the gap.** SCAPI can serve product, category, and pricing today. At spike outset the sandbox had no data because the AP21-to-SFCC feed is not built yet.
- **Dev is now seeded and verified.** `bkzk-002` has categories, pricebooks, inventory, and one sample product (priced, in stock, with a working promotion strikethrough), all consumable via SCAPI with no app-code change.
- **Interim data is manual; scale and real data need AP21.** The current sample was hand-created in Business Manager; broader and real data depend on the permanent AP21-to-MuleSoft-to-SFCC feed (SFCC-121).

---

## 2. MRT API inventory (Task 1)

The storefront consumes SFCC through the MRT proxy path `/mobify/proxy/api`, base host `{shortCode}.api.commercecloud.salesforce.com` (Dev: shortCode `qmyt7hks`, org `f_ecom_bkzk_002`, site `ZimmermannAU`). Authentication is **SLAS private-client** (guest and registered tokens; the client secret is held server-side). Requests and responses are JSON over TLS.

APIs relevant to product, category, and pricing:

| API family | Path root | Data served | Verbs | Auth |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shopper Products | `/product/shopper-products/v1/*` | Product detail (master/variant, images), **price** (`priceRanges` per pricebook), and the **category tree** (`getCategory`) | GET | SLAS |
| Shopper Search | `/search/shopper-search/v1/*` | Category product listing (`cgid` refinement), keyword search, faceting, sort | GET | SLAS |
| Shopper Login (SLAS) | `/shopper/auth/v1/*` (`oauth2` token and JWKS) | Guest and registered auth; the enabler for every read above | GET, POST | n/a |

**Payload conventions.** The storefront pulls related data in one call with `expand` (e.g. `expand=prices,promotions,variations,images`) and `perPricebook=true` for pricebook-aware pricing. Promotions surface as `productPromotions` (a `calloutMsg`, and a `promotionalPrice` at the variant level).

**Out of scope** (other problems, documented elsewhere): cart and checkout (Shopper Baskets, Shopper Orders), account and wishlist (Shopper Customers), personalization (Shopper Context, Einstein), OCAPI (configured but not called by app code), MuleSoft direct reads, and the Managed Runtime Admin API.

---

## 3. What can serve product, category, and pricing now (Task 2)

Verified by a local PWA run against dev `bkzk-002` (23-24 Jul 2026), SCAPI network traffic captured:

| Capability | API | Verified result |
|---|---|---|
| Category tree | Shopper Products `getCategory` | `clothing` and `new-arrivals` return 200; navigable |
| Category listing / search | Shopper Search | `product-search?refine=cgid=clothing` returns 200 (`total: 1`) |
| Product detail | Shopper Products | `4673TS251` returns 200 with attributes, images, variants |
| Price | Shopper Products (`expand=prices`, `perPricebook`) | 625 AUD from pricebook `au-aud-list-prices` |
| Discount / strikethrough | promotions via `expand=promotions` | 10% promo returns `promotionalPrice` 562.50 at variant level; PDP renders A$562.50 against a struck A$625 |
| Inventory | on the product record | `inventory_m_au`, ats 10, orderable |
| Auth | SLAS | guest token issued and accepted |

**Conclusion:** SCAPI serves product, category, pricing, and promotional pricing in dev today, and the storefront renders them with **no code change**. Consumption is not the blocker.

---

## 4. Current data state and how it is populated

- **Dev `bkzk-002` (verified 23-24 Jul).** Categories, pricebooks, and inventory are configured; one sample product (`4673TS251`) is present, priced and in stock with a working promotion. Business Manager first-time setup (storefront-catalogue assignment, search-index rebuild) is done. IDs in use: master catalogue `zimmermann-catalog`, storefront catalogues `zimmermann-<site>-storefront-catalog`, pricebooks `{site}-{currency}-list-prices` (e.g. `au-aud-list-prices`), inventory list `inventory_m_au`.
- **Interim (now).** Sample data is **created manually in Business Manager** by platform, because there is no AP21-to-SFCC integration yet. Additional sample data is also manual.
- **Permanent.** Product and catalogue via **AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC**; price via **AP21 to SFCC pricebook import** (there is no pricebook write API, so price is always file-based). This feed is SFCC-121's build.

*Loading-mechanism sources: Confluence Business Manager Configuration Management (309657601) and the Catalogue Sync pages (312508418, 315490342). Whether a documented `data/sample` bulk-import set exists for the sandbox is unconfirmed (open item).*

---

## 5. Limitations and gaps (Task 3)

To be covered by AP21/MuleSoft (SFCC-121) or platform:

- **Data breadth.** Dev has a single hand-made style, not enough for scale, faceting, or listing tests. More requires manual creation until the feed exists.
- **Product attributes not final.** The attribute model is still under discussion (SFCC-121); attribute-bound PDP/PLP work may need rework.
- **Sale-pricebook path unexercised.** Discount display is verified via a **promotion**; the sale-pricebook ("was/now") path is a separate mechanism and has not been tested.
- **Other sites and tiers unconfirmed.** Only `ZimmermannAU` on dev is verified; other storefronts and non-dev tiers are not checked.
- **Permanent feed pending.** AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC is not built; SFCC-121 is "Ready for Development", pending product-attribute discussions.

---

## 6. Permanent vs workaround (Task 4)

| Element | Classification |
|---|---|
| SCAPI-via-MRT for product/category/pricing consumption | **Permanent** (the storefront's supported model; no code change needed) |
| SLAS private-client auth via MRT | **Permanent** |
| AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC catalogue feed; AP21 to SFCC price feed | **Permanent** (data population; not yet built) |
| Manual Business Manager creation of sample data | **Workaround** (interim only; throwaway once the feed delivers) |
| OCAPI via MRT | Configured fallback; currently unused |

---

## 7. Open items and follow-ups (owner: Victor / platform)

- A broader sample-data set for front-end testing (multiple styles across categories).
- Whether the documented `data/sample` import works against `bkzk-002` (would enable a bulk load instead of manual creation).
- Product-attribute model finalisation (SFCC-121).
- The sale-pricebook ("was/now") path, if production markdowns are modelled as pricebooks rather than promotions.
- Per-site and per-tier seeding beyond AU/dev.
- Timeline for the permanent AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC feed (SFCC-121).

---

## References

- Codebase (`zimmermann-pwa`): `.docs/integration/01-sfcc.md`, `03-mulesoft.md`; `config/default.js`; `overrides/app/pages/home/index.tsx`, `.../components/_app-config/index.tsx`, `.../ssr.js`, `.../ssr/slasTokens.ts`.
- Confluence (space SFCC): Business Manager Configuration Management (309657601); Catalogue Sync (312508418, 315490342); TSD Product (292061208); TSD Price (292388871); Technical Solution Design, PWA (256835585).
- Jira (project SFCC): SFCC-122, SFCC-121 (Validate MuleSoft Sync), SFCC-1 (Platform Setup).
- Verification: local PWA run against dev `bkzk-002`, SCAPI network capture, 23-24 Jul 2026.
- Victor Crisostomo: sandbox and follow-up answers (23-24 Jul 2026).

---

## Changelog

- 27 Jul 2026: Reshaped from the earlier TSD-formatted draft into a spike findings / inventory doc, per review feedback (a spike needs findings, not a problem/options/decision TSD; removed PWA-implementation detail that overlapped the PWA TSD). Content carried over verified against dev and Victor.
- Earlier history: TSD-format versions v0.1 to v0.5 (22 to 24 Jul 2026).

# SFCC MRT API Capabilities: Spike Findings (SFCC-122)

> **Draft for squad review.** SFCC-122 spike deliverable: a documented inventory of the SFCC APIs available through MRT for product, category, and pricing consumption, and what can be built and tested in the lower environments before the AP21/MuleSoft feed is ready.

| | |
|---|---|
| Jira | SFCC-122 (Spike, Squad-A; epic SFCC-1 Platform Setup) |
| Author | Angelo Navarro, Squad-A / FED Lead |
| Status | Draft, for review |
| Verified against | dev sandbox `bkzk-002`, local PWA run, 23-24 Jul 2026 |

---

## 1. Summary

- **What "MRT API" means here.** Managed Runtime is the PWA Kit hosting/proxy layer. Product, category, and pricing data are served by **SCAPI (Salesforce Commerce API, the Shopper APIs)**, reached through the MRT proxy (`/mobify/proxy/api`). The separate Managed Runtime Admin API is platform / CI-CD and out of scope.
- **The APIs are ready; data was the gap.** SCAPI can serve product, category, and pricing today. At spike outset the sandbox had no data because the AP21-to-SFCC feed is not built yet.
- **Dev is now seeded and verified.** `bkzk-002` has categories, pricebooks, inventory, and one sample product (priced, in stock, with a working promotion strikethrough), all consumable via SCAPI with no app-code change.
- **Interim data is manual; scale and real data need AP21.** The current sample was hand-created in Business Manager; broader and real data depend on the permanent AP21 data feed to SFCC (SFCC-121).

---

## 2. MRT API inventory (Task 1)

The storefront consumes SFCC through the MRT proxy path `/mobify/proxy/api`, base host `{shortCode}.api.commercecloud.salesforce.com` (Dev: shortCode `qmyt7hks`, org `f_ecom_bkzk_002`, site `ZimmermannAU`). Authentication is **SLAS private-client** (guest and registered tokens; the client secret is held server-side). Requests and responses are JSON over TLS.

APIs relevant to product, category, and pricing:

| API family | Path root | Data served | Verbs | Auth |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shopper Products | `/product/shopper-products/v1/*` | Product detail (master/variant, images), **price** (`priceRanges` per pricebook), and the **category tree** (`getCategory`) | GET | SLAS |
| Shopper Search | `/search/shopper-search/v1/*` | Category product listing (`cgid` refinement), keyword search, faceting, sort | GET | SLAS |
| Shopper Login (SLAS) | `/shopper/auth/v1/*` (`oauth2` token and JWKS) | Guest and registered auth; the enabler for every read above | GET, POST | n/a |

**Payload conventions.** The storefront pulls related data in one call with `expand` (e.g. `expand=prices,promotions,variations,images`) and `perPricebook=true` for pricebook-aware pricing. Promotions surface as `productPromotions` (a `calloutMsg`, and a `promotionalPrice` at the variant level).

**Out of scope** (other problems, documented elsewhere): cart and checkout (Shopper Baskets, Shopper Orders), account and wishlist (Shopper Customers), personalization (Shopper Context, Einstein), OCAPI (configured but not called by app code), MuleSoft direct reads, and the Managed Runtime Admin API.

---

## 3. What can serve product, category, and pricing now (Task 2)

Verified by a local PWA run against dev `bkzk-002` (23-24 Jul 2026), SCAPI network traffic captured:

| Capability | API | Verified result |
|---|---|---|
| Category tree | Shopper Products `getCategory` | `clothing` and `new-arrivals` return 200; navigable |
| Category listing / search | Shopper Search | `product-search?refine=cgid=clothing` returns 200 (`total: 1`) |
| Product detail | Shopper Products | `4673TS251` returns 200 with attributes, images, variants |
| Price | Shopper Products (`expand=prices`, `perPricebook`) | 625 AUD from pricebook `au-aud-list-prices` |
| Discount / strikethrough | promotions via `expand=promotions` | 10% promo returns `promotionalPrice` 562.50 at variant level; PDP renders A$562.50 against a struck A$625 |
| Inventory | on the product record | `inventory_m_au`, ats 10, orderable |
| Auth | SLAS | guest token issued and accepted |

**Conclusion:** SCAPI serves product, category, pricing, and promotional pricing in dev today, and the storefront renders them with **no code change**. Consumption is not the blocker.

---

## 4. Current data state and how it is populated

- **Dev `bkzk-002` (verified 23-24 Jul).** Categories, pricebooks, and inventory are configured; one sample product (`4673TS251`) is present, priced and in stock with a working promotion. Business Manager first-time setup (storefront-catalogue assignment, search-index rebuild) is done. IDs in use: master catalogue `zimmermann-catalog`, storefront catalogues `zimmermann-<site>-storefront-catalog`, pricebooks `{site}-{currency}-list-prices` (e.g. `au-aud-list-prices`), inventory list `inventory_m_au`.
- **Interim (now).** Sample data is **created manually in Business Manager** by platform, because there is no AP21-to-SFCC integration yet. Additional sample data is also manual.
- **Permanent.** Product and catalogue land via the **AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC** feed. Price lands as file-based **Pricebook XML from AP21** (there is no pricebook write API, so price is always file-based); the exact delivery path (SFTP, API, or MuleSoft) is not yet confirmed (TSD Price, open item). Building this feed is SFCC-121's scope.

*Loading-mechanism sources: Confluence Business Manager Configuration Management (309657601) and the Catalogue Sync pages (312508418, 315490342). Whether a documented `data/sample` bulk-import set exists for the sandbox is unconfirmed (open item).*

---

## 5. Limitations and gaps (Task 3)

To be covered by AP21/MuleSoft (SFCC-121) or platform:

- **Data breadth.** Dev has a single hand-made style, not enough for scale, faceting, or listing tests. More requires manual creation until the feed exists.
- **Product attributes not final.** The attribute model is still under discussion (per Victor); attribute-bound PDP/PLP work may need rework.
- **Sale-pricebook path unexercised.** Discount display is verified via a **promotion**; the sale-pricebook ("was/now") path is a separate mechanism and has not been tested. (The sale strategy, promotion vs sale pricebook, is itself an open item in TSD Price.)
- **Other sites and tiers unconfirmed.** Only `ZimmermannAU` on dev is verified; other storefronts and non-dev tiers are not checked.
- **Permanent feed pending.** AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC is not built; SFCC-121 is "Ready for Development", pending product-attribute discussions.

---

## 6. Permanent vs workaround (Task 4)

| Element | Classification |
|---|---|
| SCAPI-via-MRT for product/category/pricing consumption | **Permanent** (the storefront's supported model; no code change needed) |
| SLAS private-client auth via MRT | **Permanent** |
| AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC catalogue feed; AP21 to SFCC price feed | **Permanent** (data population; not yet built) |
| Manual Business Manager creation of sample data | **Workaround** (interim only; throwaway once the feed delivers) |
| OCAPI via MRT | Configured fallback; currently unused |

---

## 7. Open items and follow-ups (owner: Victor / platform)

- A broader sample-data set for front-end testing (multiple styles across categories).
- Whether the documented `data/sample` import works against `bkzk-002` (would enable a bulk load instead of manual creation).
- Product-attribute model finalisation (SFCC-121).
- The sale-pricebook ("was/now") path, if production markdowns are modelled as pricebooks rather than promotions.
- Per-site and per-tier seeding beyond AU/dev.
- Timeline for the permanent AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC feed (SFCC-121).

---

- Jira (project SFCC): SFCC-122, SFCC-121 (Validate MuleSoft Sync), SFCC-1 (Platform Setup).
- Verification: local PWA run against dev `bkzk-002`, SCAPI network capture, 23-24 Jul 2026.
- Victor Crisostomo: sandbox and follow-up answers (23-24 Jul 2026).

- **Other sites and tiers unconfirmed.** Only `ZimmermannAU` on dev is verified; other storefronts and non-dev tiers are not checked.
-- **Permanent feed pending.** AP21 to MuleSoft to SFCC is not built; SFCC-121 is "Ready for Development", pending product-attribute discussions.

| | |
|---|---|
| Jira | SFCC-122 (Spike, Squad-A; epic SFCC-1 Platform Setup) |
| Author | Angelo Navarro, Squad-A / FED Lead |
| Status | Draft, for review |
| Verified against | dev sandbox `bkzk-002`, local PWA run, 23-24 Jul 2026 |

- **Dev is now seeded and verified.** `bkzk-002` has categories, pricebooks, inventory, and one sample product (priced, in stock, with a working promotion strikethrough), all consumable via SCAPI with no app-code change.
- **Interim data is manual; scale and real data need AP21.** The current sample was hand-created in Business Manager; broader and real data depend on the permanent AP21 data feed to SFCC (SFCC-121).
